question: Which state shows the highest literacy rate, according to Census of India 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Kerala__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the census reports of the Indian Census 2011, the literacy rate of Kerala is **94.00%.**
 
• **Kerala has the highest total literacy rate.**
 
• Male literacy stands at 96.11 percent while female literacy is at 92.07 percent.
 
• The total literacy rate of Kerala is 94% which is greater than the average literacy rate of 72.98% in India.
